anomalies.observed: On the /SkylabModule/ sheet R2, the pull-up between +3V3 and the gate of the P-channel EPD load switch Q2 (NTR2101P), is drawn with the value "10M" (10 MΩ).
anomalies.expected: The specification states the gate pull-up is 10 kΩ; a 10 MΩ pull-up is three orders of magnitude too weak for holding Q2's gate high/off.

evidence.quote: the gate pull-up R2 (10 kΩ, pulling Q2's gate high/off by default)
R2 (10 kΩ, pulling Q2's gate high/off by default) ... (10 kΩ pull-up, gate defaults high/off)
R2 value drawn as "10M" between the +3V3 node and Q2 pin 1 (gate), sheet /SkylabModule/

anomalies.impact: Q2's gate is held off by a 1000× weaker pull-up, so the EPD power switch's default-off state is high-impedance: the gate node returns to +3V3 only very slowly (10 MΩ × gate capacitance) when the SKW92A GPIO releases it, and leakage/noise can partially turn the P-channel switch on, leaving the EPD VDD rail weakly powered when it should be off.

anomalies.observed: On the /EPD_Driver/ sheet, C1 on the EPD VDD node (Display_Power_Switch to GND, next to C2 = 1 µF/6.3 V) is drawn as "0.1uF/16V".
anomalies.expected: 1 µF/25 V, the PDI G1-group default that the specification attributes to C1.

evidence.quote: | C2 default: 1 µF/25 V | C1/C5/C7/C8/C9/C10 = 1 µF/25 V | Matches default |
C1 "0.1uF/16V" on the Display_Power_Switch node to GND, sheet /EPD_Driver/ (C2 on the same node is 1uF/6.3V)

anomalies.impact: The EPD panel's VDD/VDDIO node has roughly ten times less bulk capacitance than intended (and a 16 V rather than 25 V part), giving poorer decoupling of the boost converter's switching current and more ripple on the display supply rail.

anomalies.observed: On the /EthernetAndPower/ sheet the FAN53610AUC33X feedback pin (C1 = FB) is drawn with its wire running to the GND symbol placed immediately to the right of the IC, sharing that ground node with the C2 (GND) pin, rather than running on to the +3V3 output node at C13/L2.2.
anomalies.expected: FB (pin C1) must be tied directly to the +3V3 output for this fixed-output regulator, as the specification states.

evidence.quote: FB (pin C1) → +3V3 directly (fixed-output part; this is the standard connection for a fixed-voltage FAN53610 variant).
IC1 FB pin (C1) wire terminates at the GND symbol beside IC1; no wire runs from FB to the +3V3/L2.2/C13 node, sheet /EthernetAndPower/

anomalies.impact: With the feedback input held at 0 V the regulator would drive its duty cycle to maximum and the +3V3 rail would rise toward the input voltage instead of regulating at 3.3 V, over-stressing the SKW92A module and every other 3.3 V part on the board.

parsed.summary: The drawing mostly matches the specification, but three points deviate: the Q2 gate pull-up R2 is 10 MΩ instead of the specified 10 kΩ, the EPD VDD capacitor C1 is 0.1 µF/16 V instead of 1 µF/25 V, and the FAN53610 feedback pin (FB) appears tied to GND rather than to the +3V3 output. The R2 and C1 value deviations are the best supported by the drawing; the FB ground connection, if real, is the most damaging.
